en.html:
Raichou"—Ah, enough! Our dragoons are utterly pathetic!"
Raichou"How long will they permit the great flying fortressthat thing to sit over our heads!?"
Chachamaru"Cannot help it. Enemy holds the upper position from the start; naturally we are at a disadvantage."
Chachamaru"Besides, those concealed dragoonsStealth Draco barely register on detection systemsradar. Even knowing they are there, apparently you can lose them by carelessness."
Raichou"Even so... Ah, intolerable!"
Raichou"I shall go!"
Chachamaru"There is the application. Doushin, decision?"
童心"...Well. Our preparations have finally come together."
童心"Let us lead the troops ourselves. Agreed?"
Chachamaru"Aye."
Raichou"Naturally!"

en.html:
童心"The Shichirigahama group moves north along the Fujisawa road. The Yuigahama troops apparently pass through Wakamiya Boulevard to the Kamakura road, toward Fudaraku."
Chachamaru"...Through Wakamiya Boulevard? Straight across central Kamakura?"
Chachamaru"They have decided to grab Yamato even if the citizens hate them?"
童心"No, no. First dragoons secured the boulevard."
童心"Meanwhile the main force advanced and filled・・・ it at once. Citizens have little inclination to approach a road packed with soldiers and armored vehicles..."
童心"Consequently, no civilian casualties have occurred. The advance dragoons’ stay-inside announcements and traffic closures presumably helped."
Chachamaru"...Efficient enough to annoy."

童心 「七里ヶ浜より上陸せし軍集団は藤沢街道を 北上。 　由比ヶ浜より上陸の部隊は若宮大路を抜け、 鎌倉街道へ出て普陀楽を目指すようでござる」
茶々丸 「……若宮大路を抜けてくるのか？ 　鎌倉の市街地中央突破じゃねーか」
茶々丸 「奴ら、市民に憎まれても大和を分捕るって とこまで開き直ったのかよ」
童心 「いやいや、さにあらず。 　進駐軍はまず竜騎兵を先行させて若宮大路 を確保」
童心 「その間に本隊を進め、一気に大路を埋めて・・・ しまった様子。 　となれば、兵や装甲車でぎっしりの大路に 好んで近付く市民もおらず……」
童心 「結果的に市民の被害は出ており申さぬ。 　先行した竜騎兵による市民への外出自粛の 呼び掛けと通行止めの措置も功を奏したので ござろう」
茶々丸 「……ムカつくくらい手際のいいやっちゃな」

Chachamaru"Follow-up force. Occupy Kamakura, secure supply lines."
Raichou"Yes. That can be set aside for the moment."
Raichou"The two approaching forces are the immediate problem."
Chachamaru"Oofuna and Fujisawa approaches."
童心"Yes. Now, how shall we..."
Raichou"Doushin, please remain in the inner citadel. Command the castle corps and handle air defense."
Raichou"I shall take the Oyumi contingent toward Oofuna."
Chachamaru"Then apun and Horigoe take Fujisawa. Koga and Sasagawa contingents in reserve."

en.html:
Chachamaru"Hmm-hmm."
Raichou"...What?"
Chachamaru"Nothing. Raichou looks alive again."
Chachamaru"This suits you better, no? Straightforward, understandable war, instead of politics and conspiracies."
Raichou"............"
Raichou"Yes. Perhaps it does."
童心"Hoo..."
Chachamaru"Good, good. Apun had better show some enthusiasm also."
Chachamaru"Policy settled? Hold until Shishiku returns. Reinforcements arrive, counterattack—"
Chachamaru"Scatter the besiegers, strike Yokohama."
Raichou"...Why not? Do that, and we win."
童心"Indeed. A satisfactory policy."
Chachamaru"Yes."
Chachamaru(Though no need to go quite that far...)
